content: Take 200–400 mg orally three times daily with meals. The medication can be chewed or swallowed. A dose of 200 mg orally three times daily with meals is also an option. Temporary darkening of the tongue or discoloration of the stool (dark or black) may occur while using this product, but these effects are harmless. However, hypersensitivity reactions are possible, and caution is advised in individuals with hepatic or renal impairment. If an overdose occurs, seek medical attention or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. This product is not effective in reducing odor caused by inadequate personal hygiene. It is free of gluten, lactose, and salicylates. Store the product in a cool, dry place, and do not use it if the outer safety seal or printed inner safety seal is broken. Keep it out of reach of children. Consult a healthcare professional before using this product. Studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk, making it generally acceptable for use during pregnancy.
